text: A guest registers with full name (2–50 letters; spaces . ' - allowed), unique e-mail, 10-digit Indian mobile (starts 6–9, optional +91) and age 18–120.
Passwords are 8–20 characters with upper, lower, digit and special characters and no whitespace. Three consecutive failed sign-ins lock the account for 15 minutes.
Guests search availability for a stay of 1–30 nights with check-in between today and today + 365 days; per-room-type free count and total price are shown.
Room types STANDARD (2 guests, ₹2,500), DELUXE (3, ₹4,000), FAMILY (6, ₹6,000), SUITE (4, ₹7,500). DELUXE and SUITE allow one extra bed (+1 guest, ₹800/night). Each room needs ≥ 1 adult.
A booking holds 1–5 rooms of one type for 1–10 guests and is created in PENDING state with specific rooms allocated.

Nightly price = tariff × (1 + 20 % if Fri/Sat night + 30 % if 20 Dec–5 Jan). Discounts: long stay 10 % (7–13 nights) / 15 % (≥ 14), loyalty 5/10/15 % (SILVER/GOLD/PLATINUM), promo WELCOME10 (10 %, cap ₹1,000, min ₹3,000) or FLAT500 (min ₹5,000); total discount capped at 30 %. GST on declared tariff: < ₹1,000 nil, ≤ ₹7,500 5 %, > ₹7,500 18 %.

Refund: hotel-initiated 100 % + voucher; non-refundable 0 %; refundable ≥ 7 days 100 %, 2–6 days 50 % − ₹200 fee (PLATINUM 75 %, no fee), 0–1 day 0 % (PLATINUM 25 %); no cancellation after the stay starts.

Payment by card (16 digits, Luhn-valid, unexpired, 3-digit CVV) or UPI ID within 15 minutes of booking; ₹1–₹5,00,000 per transaction; an Idempotency-Key prevents double charges; only masked card data is stored.

States PENDING → CONFIRMED → CHECKED_IN → CHECKED_OUT; PENDING/CONFIRMED → CANCELLED; PENDING → EXPIRED after 15 minutes. Check-in needs a verified ID on/after arrival date. All other transitions are rejected.
The system never allocates the same room to overlapping active bookings, including under concurrent requests.
Guests view only their own bookings; administrators view all bookings.
Administrators see daily Occupancy %, ADR and RevPAR computed from confirmed/active bookings.
Only administrators can change a guest's loyalty tier and initiate hotel-side cancellations.
Late check-out fee on nightly rate: ≤ 12:00 nil, 12:01–15:00 25 %, 15:01–18:00 50 %, after 18:00 100 %.
Free upgrade when tier ∈ {GOLD, PLATINUM} AND stay ≥ 3 nights AND room ≠ SUITE; free breakfast when tier ∈ {GOLD, PLATINUM} OR (stay ≥ 3 nights AND booked ≥ 30 days ahead).
With 25 concurrent users, API p95 latency < 300 ms and error rate < 1 %.
Price computation p95 < 5 ms.
Home page DOMContentLoaded < 1 s on a local network.
Credentials stored as salted slow hashes; no secrets, hashes or full card data in responses; sessions end on logout; no user enumeration.
All database access is parameterised; injection payloads have no effect.
Object-level and role-level authorisation on every endpoint (no IDOR, no privilege escalation).
No stored or DOM-based XSS: input is validated and output rendered as text.
Security-relevant events are written to an audit log.
Hardening headers (CSP, X-Frame-Options, nosniff, Referrer-Policy); no stack traces in errors.
A payment-gateway failure leaves the booking consistent (PENDING, no payment row) and payment can be retried.
Committed data survives a process restart.
The booking flow is completable in one page with clear validation messages and a layout that does not overflow.
WCAG 2.1 AA: no serious/critical axe-core violations; fully operable by keyboard.
Usable on phone, tablet and desktop viewports without horizontal scrolling.
Works in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit engines.
REST API publishes an OpenAPI contract and returns consistent JSON errors {error, message} with correct HTTP status codes.
A health endpoint reports service and database status.
